findings.title: This iteration's meaning-changing edits are not recorded in Change Notes
findings.detail: The Change Notes table still holds exactly 4 rows (Created; REL-BGSTAB-009 trace note; sixth-site + AC-8; per-site Rationale + AC-7). None of them covers the iteration-10 edits: the duty-partition criterion rewrite in the Requirement, the addition of 1513 to the Rationale enumeration, the narrowing of AC-8 to fitFirst-true calls, the AC-8 vacuity guard, or the '치수를 검사하는 지점 가운데' hedge. Narrowing AC-8's scope and adding a binding evidence-admissibility condition are meaning changes to an Acceptance Criterion, which SRS-MD Rules v2.5.0 §26 rule 2 requires to be recorded ('Record it when the meaning of Target, Status, Acceptance Criteria, or Requirement Statement changes'). §26 rule 1's trivial-wording exemption does not cover them. The sibling requirement REL-BGSTAB-018 recorded its analogous AC-8/vacuity-guard change as a 5th row, so the omission is also inconsistent with the file's own practice.
findings.evidence: get_requirement(REL-BGSTAB-017).changeNotes = 4 entries (lines 4322-4325); REL-BGSTAB-018 changeNotes = 5 entries incl. 'Extended the AC-7 vacuity guard ... added AC-8 boundary controls'.

findings.title: The stated duty-partition criterion does not discriminate site 5 from site 6
findings.detail: requestViewportSync is excluded because 'no caller interprets its result as barrier state'. That test is equally satisfied by the imperative fit(): it returns void and its callers (App.tsx:426, TerminalContainer.tsx:2106) discard it. fit()'s membership in the convergence set therefore rests only on AC-3 asserting the duty. The real discriminator — App.tsx handleFitAllTerminals is the explicit ResizeObserver-fallback re-fit path, i.e. the very 'resize never fires again' scenario the Rationale closes on — is not stated. No false statement and no AC contradiction results; this is a justification gap.

findings.title: AC-8 is listed before AC-7
findings.detail: The AC list order is AC-1..AC-6, AC-8, AC-7 (file lines 4289-4296; get_requirement returns them in that order). SRS-MD Rules §21.2 rule 2 says numbers increase from 1 within a Requirement Block. No validator diagnostic is emitted.

findings.title: Three line-range citations are off by one or inconsistent between sections
findings.detail: (a) Rationale cites requestViewportSync as 1146-1181 while Trace Links cites 1146-1182; the statement actually closes at 1182 (`}, [submitTerminalFit]);`). (b) AC-8 cites terminalDebugCapture.ts:394-403 — 394 is blank and the gate's early `return` is at 404-405; the precise range is 402-405. (c) The Rationale's 'isRenderable 은 다른 지점과 동일한 isVisibleRef + offsetWidth>0 + offsetHeight>0 술어다' generalizes over two partial exceptions: the visibility handler guard at 4306 omits isVisibleRef (implied by the enclosing branch) and performRepairLayout at 1190 additionally null-checks term and fitAddon. The substantive claims are unaffected in all three cases.

findings.title: '유일한 관측 수단인 recordTerminalDebugEvent' presumes the implementation channel
findings.detail: AC-8 requires 'an observable skip signal' without fixing the channel, and AC-4 explicitly allows either a debug event or a barrier-reason update. The vacuity guard however declares recordTerminalDebugEvent the sole observation means and makes capture-inactive evidence inadmissible. If an implementer chose a different observable channel, the guard as literally written would reject otherwise valid evidence. Implementation Notes do steer toward reusing fit_skipped_non_renderable, so the presumption is consistent with the intended implementation.

findings.title: Latent scope tension between AC-3 and AC-6 (pre-existing, unchanged this iteration)
findings.detail: AC-3 requires an invisible imperative fit() call to join the retry path; AC-6 requires that the retry path NOT activate when the container has non-zero dimensions from the start. A container that is non-zero-sized but flagged not-visible (isVisibleRef false without display:none) satisfies both antecedents. AC-6's '정상 경로' qualifier arguably scopes it to the normal mount path, so the tension is likely resolvable by reading; no new defect was introduced this iteration.

findings.title: Verification Method describes no method for AC-8
findings.detail: The Verification Method row names AC-4 and AC-7 explicitly and describes the unit/E2E fit scenarios, but says nothing about requestViewportSync or the capture-enabled precondition. The binding guard is fully self-contained inside AC-8, so a verifier reading the AC has what is needed; REL-BGSTAB-018 by contrast folded its AC-8 controls into the Verification Method.
